hints.title: Divisibility Connectivity
hints.text: Two elements share a path whenever they share a common prime divisor.

hints.title: Bipartite Prime Connections
hints.text: Instead of connecting pairs directly, connect each number to its prime factors.

hints.title: Single Component Verification
hints.text: Verify that all elements end up in the exact same connected component.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Union

complexity.notes: Prime factorization drives component grouping with path compression.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise gcd computation takes O(n^2 * log(max_val)) which times out for large n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint set mapping stores components efficiently.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Bridges integers via prime divisors rather than quadratic graph construction.
